source_prompt: A young female witch with long curly brown hair wearing a blue coat stands inside the open doorway of a magical wooden shop built into a massive ancient tree at night. The shop has bookshelves filled with potions, spellbooks, and jars. A wooden sign reads 'MOSS & MANTLE - SPELLS & SUNDRIES'. Hanging paper scrolls, glowing lanterns, and twisted branches surround the structure. The forest floor is covered in ferns and glowing white mushrooms.
